title: Points of Light
excerpt: 10 years of research, 14 million data points, 14 laser projectors, turning the Grote Kerk into a real-time light environment.
description:
> Ten years of research. 14 million data points. 14 laser projectors.
What started a decade ago as a research project between Jaco Schilp and Jan Willem Campmans has finally pushed through the technical ceiling, turning the historic Grote Kerk in Den Haag into a real-time data environment. Using TouchDesigner's POP operators, the work runs a full LiDAR 3D scan of the cathedral, 14 million particles calibrated in real time. No pre-renders, no loops: raw architecture translated into light.
Visitors experience the intersection of history and high-performance code. Presented in January 2026 in 15-minute projections, free entry.
credits: Video animations & custom calibration: Studio Schilp (TouchDesigner). Digital light animations: Sem Schreuder (Unreal Engine). Sound: Alejandra Metztli. Projectors sponsored by Epson. Hosted at Grote Kerk Den Haag / the Greanery. Film: Jokko Voogt.
